1.title: Scene 1 — Fuzzby’s Pollination Lesson
1.promise: Fuzzby’s joyful performance of expertise becomes increasingly visible failure, while Zenny’s restrained amusement shows that she sees and loves exactly who he is.

beats.title: Chase
beats.intent: Fuzzby pursues pollen through the corridor.
beats.scriptTruth: Fuzzby enters as joyful chaos, trying to look expert while barely controlling the route.
beats.visibleProof: The audience sees a clear bee-height chase lane and two escalating near-misses.
beats.startState: Open flower corridor ahead; Fuzzby already overcommitted; Zenny clean and outside his path.
beats.actionPath: Drone-like pursuit → two near-misses → flower contact setup.
beats.endState: Fuzzby is still moving forward with room for the first crash.
beats.camera: Bee-height chase camera, slightly late, no confusing cuts.
checklist: Two near-misses have room to stage
beats.promptSegment: Chase prompt segment: bee-height drone pursuit, open corridor, two readable near-misses, Zenny safely parallel.
beats.reviewNote: Chase route is readable and has room for escalation.

beats.title: False Triumph
beats.intent: Fuzzby converts a crash into a proud finish.
beats.scriptTruth: The leaf recoil accidentally gives Fuzzby a gymnast-style recovery he pretends was planned.
beats.visibleProof: Flower scoop, springy leaf impact, recoil rotation, chest-out hover.
beats.startState: Fuzzby dives too hard into a flower.
beats.actionPath: Face contact → leaf bend → recoil → tucked rotation → proud hover.
beats.endState: Fuzzby is upright, proud and physically unsettled.
beats.camera: Hold the cause chain and settle on the false triumph.
checklist: Fuzzby has a clear chest-forward hover
Space exists for later flower action
beats.promptSegment: False Triumph prompt segment: flower scoop, springy leaf recoil, tucked rotation and proud hover with residual wobble.
beats.reviewNote: False triumph reads as accidental success rather than real competence.

beats.title: Pollen Moustache
beats.intent: Escalate Fuzzby’s false expertise into a readable visual joke.
beats.scriptTruth: Fuzzby gets two pollen curls on his upper lip and presents them as authority.
beats.visibleProof: The pollen moustache must read before Zenny reacts.
beats.startState: Fuzzby centre-left; separate target flower centre-right; Zenny frame-left and outside his travel route.
beats.actionPath: Forward arc → face contacts target flower → pollen transfers → same-path return → presentation hold → Zenny reacts.
beats.endState: Two upper-lip pollen curls are visible, target flower remains visible, Fuzzby holds proudly.
beats.camera: Medium-wide, warm corridor, target flower and return position both readable.
beats.timing: Reveal hold around 0.8s before Zenny response.
checklist: Fuzzby’s forward route to flower is clear
Camera keeps flower, Fuzzby and Zenny readable
No moustache exists in setup frame
revealChecklist: Target flower remains visible in background
Fuzzby is in planned reveal position
Fuzzby holds proudly before Zenny reacts
Zenny’s eye-line lands on moustache first
beats.recommendedFix: Generate the Moustache Setup keyframe, then the Moustache Reveal keyframe, and use them as anchors for a dedicated 7.4-second Seedance shot.
beats.promptSegment: Moustache Setup prompt segment: Fuzzby centre-left, separate target flower centre-right, Zenny outside route, no moustache yet. Reveal segment: same flower remains visible, two upper-lip pollen curls, proud hold before Zenny reacts.
beats.reviewNote: Target flower and upper-lip moustache are unclear; route drifted toward Zenny instead of returning to the reveal position.

beats.title: Zenny Reaction
beats.intent: Zenny’s deadpan lands after the evidence.
beats.scriptTruth: Zenny judges the accident with restraint and affection.
beats.visibleProof: Her eyes move from moustache to Fuzzby before the response lands.
beats.startState: Moustache visible; Fuzzby presenting; Zenny close but outside route.
beats.actionPath: Evidence read → eye move → almost-smile → deadpan response.
beats.endState: Zenny’s affection is visible without broad mugging.
beats.camera: Relationship composition; no cut before the joke reads.
checklist: Eye movement is directed to moustache, then Fuzzby
One mouth corner only just lifts
Reaction has no broad expression or early action
beats.promptSegment: Zenny Reaction prompt segment: moustache already established, Zenny almost still, eyes to moustache then Fuzzby, tiny mouth-corner lift only.
beats.reviewNote: Reaction must wait until the moustache is visually established.

beats.title: Final Warmth
beats.intent: Fuzzby worsens the mess and Zenny loves him anyway.
beats.scriptTruth: A second failure becomes a warm character button.
beats.visibleProof: Fuzzby pops out more pollen-covered; Zenny eye-roll softens into love.
beats.startState: Fuzzby still marked with pollen; Zenny clear of the route.
beats.actionPath: Wipe-smear → overcommit → flower contacts → pop-up pose → softened eye-roll.
beats.endState: Golden dust hangs between Fuzzby and Zenny’s smiling eye-roll.
beats.camera: Follow causal tumble, then hold the final relationship frame.
checklist: Final pose keeps both characters readable
The shot ends on a usable handoff frame
beats.promptSegment: Final Warmth prompt segment: Fuzzby worsens the pollen mess, pops into final readable pose, Zenny eye-roll softens into love, held handoff frame.
beats.reviewNote: Final warmth depends on a held two-character payoff, not more random chaos.
